name: Aly Orady
current_role: Founder of Tonal (CEO 2015-2023, then CTO; one profile lists him as founder/board member & advisor since Jan 2025)
profile: Engineer (McMaster computer engineering; Samsung, Sun, HP and enterprise startups) who founded Tonal, the electromagnetic-resistance smart home gym, in 2015. He led it as CEO until 2023, when it raised $130M and he moved to CTO; Tonal later appointed new CEOs (Todd Bartee named CEO in 2026).
interesting_fact: Tonal was born of his own health turnaround: after developing type 2 diabetes and sleep apnea he lost 70 pounds in nine months in 2014, then in March 2015 looked at a gym cable machine and wondered if electricity could replace its weight plates.
deep_cut_fact: He built the first Tonal prototypes himself on a wooden workbench at home with parts ordered online; the first version used a single magnet and gave only 25-40 lb of usable resistance, and he had studied electromagnetics at university but never built such a device in his jobs.
